findings.reason: «محفوظ» alone is the completed-state participle («saved»), but the label replaces the pin/unpin action while the request is still in flight; the locale's own busy state is «محفوظ ہو رہا ہے…» (relay.session.tags.saving). Proposed form is 13 cells against a 12-cell budget, so confirm in the rendered pass; a pin-specific fallback is «پن محفوظ…» (9 cells).
Reads as «start/started», not «starting»; every other busy state in the file is a progressive (نشان زد ہو رہا ہے…, منسلک ہو رہا ہے…). Proposed form is exactly 12 cells, the stated budget.

findings.proposed: آف لائن · دوبارہ کوشش ہو رہی ہے
findings.reason: The other two select branches are states/clauses; the bare noun phrase reads like the retry affordance itself (the locale's button is «دوبارہ کوشش کریں»). Proposed form is 31 cells against a 32-cell budget.

findings.current: جواب نہیں دے رہا — پیغام روکے ہیں
findings.proposed: جواب نہیں دے رہا — پیغام قطار میں ہے
findings.reason: Singular «پیغام» with plural «روکے ہیں» is an agreement slip, and «روکے» reads as blocked rather than queued-then-delivered (English: «sends will wait»). «قطار میں» is the locale's established queued phrasing (wire.settings.asks.description); the proposed form is exactly 36 cells, the budget. Minimal alternative: «پیغامات روکے ہیں» (35 cells).

findings.proposed: گفتگوئیں ٹیگ کے حساب سے گروپ کریں
findings.reason: «ٹیگ سے گروپ کریں» is a Hindi-ised instrumental calque; Urdu uses «کے حساب سے / کے مطابق». Proposed form is 33 cells against a 36-cell budget.

findings.proposed: record one decision for Library — keep «لائبریری» in the drawer and align wire.settings.librarian.description, or add a glossary row making Library a kept-English surface name
findings.reason: The same English term renders as «لائبریری» here and as Latin «Library» in wire.settings.librarian.description; the glossary is silent, so the locale currently has two renderings of one term. Recommendation: the drawer label is the better native form; record it and align the prose.

The button reads «جاری رکھیں» (Resume) while the busy state says «opening», a different verb; «دوبارہ کھولیں» is attested for reopening sessions, so the current form is defensible, but matching the button's verb is cleaner. Proposed form is exactly 12 cells, the budget.

findings.current: دوبارہ منسلک ہو رہا ہے · # سیکنڈ پہلے / · # منٹ پہلے
findings.proposed: دوبارہ منسلک… · آخری اپ ڈیٹ # سیکنڈ پہلے / · # منٹ پہلے
findings.reason: English pins the time to «last synced»; without a referent «# سیکنڈ پہلے» can be read as the outage age. The proposed forms are 41 and 39 cells against 44; the full reconnect clause plus «آخری اپ ڈیٹ» does not fit 44, hence the shortened clause — confirm visually. Acceptable as-is if the rendered line reads clearly under the title.
